reconciliation: PK versus PD; active-drug inactivation versus prodrug activation.
Star allele is not a severity rank; copy count does not establish functional copies.
Phenoconversion does not alter DNA; no blanket CYP2D6 induction claim.
CPIC thiopurine2025 update published2026 includes TPMT and NUDT15.
DPYD gene distinct from DPD enzyme; systemic/topical and renal uracil context preserved.
ABCB1 substrate is not a therapeutic target; SLCO1B1 uptake distinguished.
HLA risk distinct from metabolism; no historical hapten diagram adopted.
Host germline, tumor somatic and pathogen genomes separated; biologics undergo proteolysis.
Siponimod CYP2C9 case retained with current EMA context.
No doses, universal screening mandate, ethnicity-as-genotype, or whole-corpus claim.
